classification.difficultyReason: Construct a sum and difference of two supplied vectors using a square grid.

content.prompt: Given each set of vectors $\underset{\sim}{a}$ and $\underset{\sim}{b}$, draw:

spec.description: An 8 by 8 grid supplies both vectors for both parts. A blank-grid template cannot express the arrows and undertilde labels.
spec.mathematics: a goes three cells right and two up; b goes two cells right and two down.

spec.description: Blank 24-column by 9-row square-cell grid shared by the two parts. TikZ preserves the periodically heavier guide lines, which the blank-grid template cannot express.
spec.mathematics: Left twelve columns serve part a; right twelve columns serve part b. Grid step is one in both coordinate directions; no axes or coordinate labels are printed.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer arrows appear in the student edition.

answer.short: An arrow 5 grid cells to the right.
answer.worked: Place $\underset{\sim}{b}$ tip to tail after $\underset{\sim}{a}$. The 2 cells up and 2 cells down cancel; the rightward distances total $3+2=5$ cells. Draw the resultant from the first tail to the final tip.

spec.description: Complete left response region with the supplied horizontal resultant reconstructed in ordinary answer ink.
spec.mathematics: Resultant displacement is five cells right and zero vertically.

answer.short: An arrow 1 grid cell right and 4 grid cells up.
answer.worked: Subtract by adding the negative: $\underset{\sim}{a}-\underset{\sim}{b}=\underset{\sim}{a}+(-\underset{\sim}{b})$. Reverse $\underset{\sim}{b}$, giving 2 cells left and 2 cells up, and place it tip to tail after $\underset{\sim}{a}$. The resultant goes $3-2=1$ cell right and $2+2=4$ cells up.

spec.description: Complete right response region with the supplied upward-right resultant reconstructed in ordinary answer ink.
spec.mathematics: Resultant displacement is one cell right and four cells up.
